review.instruction: Confirm route, rung, desired-state digest, mutable ceiling, allowed effects, capability custody, inventory fingerprint and environment authority were bound before any effect.
Confirm the route keeps its declared fixed port, every holder is identified, and no foreign or uncertain process is stopped or reconfigured to reclaim a port.

For serve, verify the session commit is contained in the served head, integration uses merge or valid fast-forward without rebase or force, conflicts touch only owned hunks under closed rules, and gates pass on the merged head.
Match inventory, requested effects, applied mutations and check set to the selected runtime rung. Already-converged results have paired read-only proof and zero mutations.
Probe every declared endpoint and bind the answering process, generation, integration branch and served head. A missing or failed rung check cannot be described as serving.
On uncertain completion, inventory the entry, process and served head again before any command. Reuse converged state and never blindly repeat restart, reset, merge or stop.

failurePolicy: Turn failed checks into exact inventory, port, integration or probe defects. Repair within two rounds, re-observe before effect retries, and block wider or unauthorized changes.
